name: Martin Wills Wildlife Maintenance Trust
summary: Small grants for wildlife charities in the UK and Ireland running projects that protect species and restore and improve habitats.

applicant_types.quote: The Martin Wills Wildlife Maintenance Trust provides grants of £1,000 to £3,000 to small wildlife charities working in the UK and Ireland for projects that protect species and restore habitats.
